preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only the characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_correct_parenthesis_sequence(s[:i]) for i in range(1, len(s)))
postconditions.description: All strict prefixes of the new sequence are not correct parenthesis sequences.
The new sequence is a correct parenthesis sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s)
postconditions.description: The new sequence contains only the characters '(' and ')'.

postconditions.expression: s == ':(' or all(c in '()' for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output is either a valid sequence of '(' and ')' or the failure sentinel ':('.
